The '''''Myrenia''''' was [[Coh Veshiv]]'s personal [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], stationed aboard the ''[[Empire Forever]]''. When Veshiv was captured by [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]] and the crew of the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', they also took control of the ''Myrenia''.
